definition: Unique users with >=1 monitored LLM session per ISO week
measurement_formula: COUNTD(user_id) of monitoring_sessions per week, averaged per month
significance_interpretation: Captures the core value loop: a user only counts if they actually observed their LLMs through monitr-ai. One guardrail metric aligning acquisition, activation and retention.

definition: Share of unique marketing-site visitors who create an account
significance_interpretation: Measures top-of-funnel message-market fit of the landing page.

definition: Share of new accounts that connect at least one LLM provider API key
measurement_formula: users with >=1 row in api_key_configs / signups * 100
significance_interpretation: The biggest intentional-friction step in onboarding (API key entry). Gates every downstream metric.

definition: Share of signups arriving via invite codes or the referral channel
significance_interpretation: Pre-launch growth is pure word-of-mouth; this measures the health of the viral loop while there is no paid marketing scale.

definition: Share of signups who run their first monitoring session within 7 days of connecting a key
significance_interpretation: Activation = first moment of realized value (live token efficiency / CRI). Strongest predictor of W4 retention.

definition: Median days from account creation to first monitoring session
significance_interpretation: Every extra day before first value multiplies abandonment risk.

definition: Share of signups finishing >=4 of 5 onboarding steps
significance_interpretation: Users who finish onboarding connect keys at ~1.2x the rate; incomplete onboarding predicts early inactivity.

definition: Unique users with >=1 session in the month
significance_interpretation: Core reach metric of the product's recurring value.

definition: Average daily actives as share of monthly actives
significance_interpretation: Observability is episodic (incident-driven); alerts and digests convert reactive use into habit.

definition: Average monitored sessions per active user per month
significance_interpretation: Depth of usage distinguishes power users from drive-by evaluators.

definition: Share of monthly active users with >=8 sessions in the month
measurement_formula: COUNTD(users with >=8 sessions in month) / MAU * 100
significance_interpretation: Power users anchor retention and drive most of the monitored token volume; growing this share is the key pre-launch lever.

definition: Share of a signup cohort still active in week 4 after activation
measurement_formula: cohort users with >=1 session in activation+[28,35)d / cohort size
significance_interpretation: The PMF litmus test; flat curves after week 4 signal durable habit.

definition: Share of users active this month who are also active next month
significance_interpretation: Pre-launch 'churn' is inactivity, not cancellation - this is the direct measure of it.

definition: Share of activated users with no session in the last 30 days
significance_interpretation: Substitute for churn in a pre-launch product; spikes usually trace to onboarding drop-offs or semester breaks (campus segment).

definition: Proprietary 0-1 score: semantic drift + token inefficiency + quality loss (lower is better)
significance_interpretation: The metric users come to monitr-ai to reduce; a falling platform-wide average evidences real delivered value.

definition: Useful output tokens / total tokens exchanged (higher is better)
significance_interpretation: Translates directly to the monitored LLM spend that monitr-ai optimizes.

measurement_formula: AVG(cri_avg) over sessions; level bands min/low/mod/high/critical
significance_interpretation: Headline trust-safety KPI; drives zero-trust enforcement actions.

definition: Rate of security detections (injection, PII, leakage) normalized by usage
significance_interpretation: Rising with adversarial-test adoption is healthy; rising in production traffic signals attacks.

definition: Net Promoter Score surveyed ~7 days after activation
significance_interpretation: Predicts invite/referral growth - the only growth engine that exists pre-launch.
